_readme: Each slot is one image on the site. To swap in a real photo: paste a direct download URL into sourceUrl (Unsplash: the photo page's Download link; Pexels: the original image URL), fill in photographer, sourcePage and license, then run `npm run images`. The script downloads, resizes and converts to WebP at every width listed and rewrites CREDITS.md. Leave sourceUrl empty to keep the generated illustration.
